title: UOyisa kunye nomthi omkhulu
description: UOyisa uthanda iziqhamo, kodwa akazange azi ukuba iimbewu zinganomlingo! Xa imbewu ikhula ibengumthi omkhulu, uzibona ephezulu phezu komhlaba. Kuyakuvela wuphi ummangaliso bethu?
subjects: Nature and looking after our planet
